messages:
lin: Runtime merged change: default batching -> "aggressive" and a new quant profile "q8-dynmix". Need a short release note, migration steps, and SDK snippet updates (py + js). cc @rachel @samir
rachel: On it. Can someone confirm the concise user-facing bullets I should call out?
samir: Bullets from runtime: 1) default `batching.policy` -> "aggressive" (better throughput for long sequences) 2) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` available on x86-gpu images 3) legacy q4_0/q4_1 still supported but marked deprecated.
morgan: Known issue: small-sequence (sub-100 token) latency can increase ~10-20ms in low-concurrency environments. We should show opt-out and a per-route override in Console.
lin: Snippets needing update: py example that used `batching=None` -> show explicit opt-out with `batching.policy = "none"` and how to pin `quant_profile` per-request.
rachel: Draft Python snippet to drop into the relnote/docs: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1-small", prompt=prompt, config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"})
```
rachel: I'll add the JS snippet once wording is approved.
samir: Migration doc: add Console/global opt-out steps, private-deploy CLI example, and per-route override examples. Also link to runtime kernel-selection note (/docs/runtime/kernel-selection) and validate anchors.
docops-bot: link-check queued for docs repo (run id 5120). Will post results here.
docops-bot: link-check finished (run id 5120)   1 broken anchor found: kernel-selection.md#old-kernels -> should be kernel-selection.md#kernel-selection. Filed docs issue #803.
rachel: I'll update the PR with py/js snippets, Known Issue blurb, and the anchor fix. Draft relnote text: "Default batching updated to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. If you rely on sub-100-token latency, you may see slightly higher tail latency; to restore prior behavior set `batching.policy: 'none'` in your client config or pin a per-route override in Console."
samir: Add private-deploy CLI example for docs: ```bash
redwoodctl set global-config --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1
```
morgan: QA reminder: run perf suites with representative sequence-length distributions before toggling defaults. Tag Dedicated ops for canary rollouts.
lin: Action items: Rachel -> update PR with py/js snippets + Known Issue; Samir -> add migration CLI + private deploy instructions; Morgan -> ops rollout notes + Dedicated handbook mention; DocOps -> resolve docs#803 and re-run link-check. I'll merge the relnote once snippets land and CI is green. :thumbsup:
